page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (an "An.1557" year note at left margin, and small marginal numerals at right); page number at head.

main_text.p:
Cæsarem & Hispanos pro Regno Neapolitano vindicaret, cupiditate inceptis obstaret, seq; officii muneribus, sui in ea causa quam redarguia quosq; nollet, admoneret. Itaq; Papa abrogata Poli legatione eum Romam revocavit, eiusque loco Petrum Peto Franciscani ordinis virum Cardinalem atque Legatum creavit. At vt in Polum citatum ante quàm Romam adueniret crimimum probationumque copiam exquireret, Moronum Cardinalem Angliæ vt (diximus) in Romana curia protectorem Poli familiarissimum in vincula conjecit. Hæc omnia Mariæ Reginæ priusquam Polo nuncia banturque cum ea ad Papam nuncia...
[Transcription of the full page continues as printed; text partially illegible in the scan.]

page.notes: The scan is low resolution and skewed; the full running text of the page is only partly legible, so the transcription above is incomplete and should be checked against the original. The year note "An.1557" stands in the left margin. The page contains two columns of Latin text in a continuous block; the lower paragraphs (about Cantebrigiae, Oxoniensem, Cutberto Scoto, Pauli Phagii, Martini Buceri) are not fully transcribed. Marginal numerals at right (19, 29, 30, 40, 50) mark the lines of the column.
